outcome: Accuracy of clinically estimated fetal weight (EFW)
cohort: Singleton births ≥24 weeks gestation with EFW recorded up to 1 week before delivery, from 2014-2020
finding: Inaccurate EFW occurred in 30.7% of cases, with underestimation linked to increased risk of shoulder dystocia and perineal lacerations, and overestimation associated with neonatal composite adverse outcome, induced labor, and Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Overestimation of birth weight was associated with increased rates of induced labor and Cesarean delivery.
